title: Hurt Defined
statutory_text: Whoever causes bodily pain, disease or infirmity to any person is said to cause hurt.
clinical_criteria: Superficial injuries confined to skin and subcutaneous tissues without bone injury, permanent disfigurement, or life danger.

title: Voluntarily Causing Hurt
statutory_text: Whoever does any act with the intention of thereby causing hurt to any person, or with the knowledge that he is likely thereby to cause hurt to any person, and thereby causes hurt to any person, is said 'voluntarily to cause hurt'.
clinical_criteria: Documentation of trauma caused with intent or knowledge.

title: Grievous Hurt: Emasculation
statutory_text: The following kinds of hurt only are designated as grievous, namely:— First.— Emasculation.
clinical_criteria: Trauma depriving a male patient of masculine vigor or severe genitourinary maiming.

title: Grievous Hurt: Permanent Privation of Sight of Either Eye
statutory_text: Secondly.— Permanent privation of the sight of either eye.
clinical_criteria: Direct eye trauma with structural disruption causing permanent impairment or total loss of vision in one or both eyes.

title: Grievous Hurt: Permanent Privation of Hearing of Either Ear
statutory_text: Thirdly.— Permanent privation of the hearing of either ear.
clinical_criteria: Permanent sensory or conductive deafness resulting from physical assault or blast injury.

title: Grievous Hurt: Privation of Any Member or Joint
statutory_text: Fourthly.— Privation of any member or joint.
clinical_criteria: Complete anatomical loss or severance of any bodily limb, organ, digit, or joint.

title: Grievous Hurt: Destruction or Permanent Impairing of Powers of Member/Joint
statutory_text: Fifthly.— Destruction or permanent impairing of the powers of any member or joint.
clinical_criteria: Loss of physiological function or motor/sensory capacity of a limb or joint without physical detachment.

title: Grievous Hurt: Permanent Disfiguration of Head or Face
statutory_text: Sixthly.— Permanent disfiguration of the head or face.
clinical_criteria: Visible scar, alteration of facial symmetry, or loss of aesthetic integrity on cranium, forehead, cheek, nose, or lips.

title: Grievous Hurt: Fracture or Dislocation of a Bone or Tooth
statutory_text: Seventhly.— Fracture or dislocation of a bone or tooth.
clinical_criteria: Break or breach in bone continuity, displacement of articulating joint surfaces, or traumatic loss/loosening of dental structures. Requires radiographic / orthodontic confirmation in ER.

title: Grievous Hurt: Endangering Life or 20-Day Severe Bodily Pain / Inability
statutory_text: Eighthly.— Any hurt which endangers life or which causes the sufferer to be during the space of twenty days in severe bodily pain, or unable to follow his ordinary pursuits.
clinical_criteria: Injury placing the patient in imminent mortal peril, or traumatic incapacity requiring bed rest/hospitalization for twenty days or more.

title: Voluntarily Causing Hurt/Grievous Hurt by Dangerous Weapons or Means
statutory_text: Whoever voluntarily causes hurt or grievous hurt by means of any instrument for shooting, stabbing or cutting, or any instrument which, used as a weapon of offence, is likely to cause death, or by means of fire or any heated substance...
clinical_criteria: Injury caused by instruments of cutting, stabbing, shooting, burning, or lethal mechanical energy.
